decisions.question: D12-Q01
decisions.rule: All three hosts run Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, the only system the node's execution policy has run on (kernel 6.8, AppArmor 4.0.1, whose abi/4.0 file the policy pins). Nothing else runs on a host.

decisions.question: D12-Q01
decisions.rule: Each host's public IPv4 address is on its own network interface, one per node, with no NAT, so the engine listens on, dials from and firewalls the same address. This replaces the static 1:1 NAT wording of the production activation design (D12-Q01) and requires a provider that assigns the public address to the host's interface.

decisions.question: D12-Q01
decisions.rule: Node keys (validator key and fresh signing state, peer seed, endpoint client channel seed) are made offline on the ceremony machine. Each host gets one public bundle: the release, its generated files, the chain's genesis and root signatures, and its node keys sealed under a passphrase with AES-256. At the console only the bundle's SHA-256 and the passphrase are typed; the host downloads it, checks the digest, unseals and installs it. Nothing has to come off a host, and the sealed keys are their backup.

decisions.question: D12-Q01
decisions.rule: Service account: system user and group dytallix, UID and GID 41001, no login. Release binaries in /opt/dytallix/RELEASE/bin, root-owned, read-only and immutable; policy and node inputs in /etc/dytallix/RELEASE, root-owned; node home /var/lib/dytallix/node (0700) with lock, metrics, snapshot, light-block and scratch directories under /var/lib/dytallix; one systemd unit, dytallix-node.service, runs the supervisor.
